fields.title: Explain it simply
fields.body: Explain the following concept as if I am meeting it for the first time. Start with a one-sentence summary, then a simple example, then the common mistakes people make:

fields.title: Quiz me
fields.body: Write 5 multiple-choice questions to test my understanding of the topic below. Put the answers, with a one-line explanation each, at the end:

fields.title: Summarise my notes
fields.body: Summarise these notes into clear bullet points grouped by theme, and list anything that looks unclear or missing:

fields.title: Check my essay
fields.body: Review this paragraph for clarity, grammar and argument. Show the corrected version first, then explain the three most important changes:

fields.title: Debug my code
fields.body: Find the bug in this code. Explain what is wrong, why it happens, and show the fixed version:

fields.title: Step-by-step solution
fields.body: Solve this problem step by step, explaining the reasoning at each step so I can do a similar one on my own:

fields.label: Context budget (tokens)
fields.help_text: How much conversation history is re-sent with each message. Older messages are replaced by a short summary rather than dropped.

fields.label: Suggest follow-up questions
fields.help_text: Each answer ends with three one-tap follow-up questions. They are written in the same reply (no extra request), adding roughly 30-50 output tokens per answer.

fields.label: Context window (messages)
fields.help_text: How many previous messages are sent with each request. Every one of them is re-sent, and paid for, on every message — raise it only if the assistant starts losing the thread.

fields.label: Summarise long conversations
fields.help_text: When history outgrows the budget, fold the older part into a short summary instead of losing it. Costs one small call per few messages.

fields.value:
You are the EPC AI Assistant, a study partner for students.
- Lead with the answer, in as few words as a complete answer needs. No preamble, recap or sign-off.
- Be right before brief: check every calculation, unit and final answer. If information is missing, state your assumption. If the student is wrong, say so and correct it.
- Say when unsure; never invent facts, sources, links or figures.
- Maths and science: numbered steps, one per line, final answer in bold with units. Write maths in plain text with Unicode (x², √2, π, ≤, ×, (a+b)/c), never LaTeX.
- Code: complete and runnable, in a fenced block with its language; for a fix, add one sentence on what was wrong.
- Markdown renders; use lists, tables or ## headings only when they help, never nested lists.
- Reply in the language the student wrote in.
- This platform draws pictures: never say it can't; tell the student to ask, e.g. "create an image of a red bicycle".
fields.label: System prompt
fields.help_text: Sets the assistant's behaviour for every conversation.

fields.label: Enable image input
fields.help_text: Allow students to attach images in chat.

fields.label: Allow sharing conversations
fields.help_text: Students can publish a read-only link to a conversation. Turning this off hides the Share button and makes every existing link stop working.

fields.label: Switch model when one runs out
fields.help_text: When the chosen model has no room left — no tokens, or a daily, weekly or monthly ceiling reached — answer with another model the student already holds tokens for, instead of refusing. The switch is always shown in the conversation and the reply is billed to the model that actually answered.

fields.label: Allow custom instructions
fields.help_text: Students can tell the assistant about themselves and how they like answers written. Their text is added to every request they send.

fields.label: Expiry reminder days
fields.help_text: Send subscription reminders this many days before expiry.

fields.label: E-mail low token warnings
fields.help_text: Send the low-balance warning to the student's registered e-mail address, through the same account verification codes use.

fields.label: Low token warning points (%)
fields.help_text: E-mail the student when a model's balance falls to each of these percentages of what they were allocated. A percentage rather than a fixed count, so the same rule means the same thing on a 10,000-token package and a 200,000-token one. Each point is sent once per model until the student tops that model up.

fields.label: Low token threshold
fields.help_text: Students are alerted when their balance drops below this number.

fields.label: Critical token threshold
fields.help_text: A second, more urgent alert at this balance.

fields.label: Daily admin digest
fields.help_text: Every morning (after 8 am Phnom Penh) each administrator gets the last 24 hours — sign-ups, payments, tokens, errors, tickets, model status — on Telegram and by e-mail. Sent by the hourly send_reminders job.

fields.label: Application name
fields.help_text: Shown in the UI and e-mails.

fields.label: Pause all chat (maintenance)
fields.help_text: Stops new messages to every model. Students can still read, search and export their chats, and see the note below. Administrators are not affected.

fields.label: Maintenance message
fields.help_text: Shown to students while chat is paused, e.g. "Back by 9:00 pm — we're upgrading."

fields.label: Live answers (word by word)
fields.help_text: Show answers as they are written. Off: each answer appears when it is complete.

fields.label: Dashboard banner
fields.help_text: Optional message shown on student dashboards.

fields.label: Search by meaning
fields.help_text: Let students find past answers by what they mean, not only by exact words. Needs an OpenAI-compatible embeddings key (EMBEDDING_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY).

fields.label: Public signup
fields.help_text: Allow students to register themselves.

fields.label: Support e-mail
fields.help_text: Where students should write.

fields.label: Support Telegram
fields.help_text: Optional @handle for support.

fields.label: Enable free trial
fields.help_text: Turn the welcome grant on or off for new signups.

fields.label: Free trial tokens
fields.help_text: Credited once, in the default model (GPT-5 Mini), when a new account is verified. Every other model starts at zero.

fields.label: Referral bonus — new user
fields.help_text: Tokens awarded to the person who signed up with a code.

fields.label: Referral bonus — referrer
fields.help_text: Tokens awarded to the person who shared the code.

fields.label: Enable referrals
fields.help_text: Allow referral codes at signup.

fields.label: Payment window (minutes)
fields.help_text: How long a student has to finish paying before the order expires and a new one has to be started. The gateways are told the same limit.

fields.label: KHR exchange rate
fields.help_text: Riel per US dollar, used to price KHR payments (ABA PayWay, ACLEDA). Fixed on each order when it is created, so changing it never alters an order that is already open.

fields.label: Manual confirmation fallback
fields.help_text: When a gateway has no credentials yet, offer a manual transfer that an administrator confirms from the Payments page. Turn off to hide such methods entirely.

fields.label: OTP length
fields.help_text: Number of digits in a verification code.

fields.label: OTP lifetime (minutes)
fields.help_text: How long a verification code stays valid.

fields.label: Require verification
fields.help_text: New students must verify by e-mail or Telegram before chatting.

fields.label: One active session
fields.help_text: Signing in on a new device signs the account out everywhere else.

fields.value: Hello! I need help with my EPC AI Assistant account.
fields.label: WhatsApp opening message
Telegram alerts
fields.help_text: Send students' alerts to their linked Telegram chat. Off: alerts stay in the app (and e-mail); sign-in codes still go to Telegram for students who chose it.

fields.label: Plan expiry
fields.help_text: Reminders before a plan ends, and when it has ended.

fields.label: Payments
fields.help_text: Payment confirmed, failed, expired or refunded.

fields.label: Referral rewards
fields.help_text: Tokens earned by inviting friends.

fields.label: Support and messages
fields.help_text: Support replies, messages from the team and account changes.

fields.label: Tokens
fields.help_text: Low-balance warnings and tokens added by an administrator.
